blocks.title: Voice shopping latency budget
rows: Fetch the token on the consent tap, or when the panel opens once consent exists
A second tap, or under a second of silence after speech
Nothing heard after about 5 s; a 15-second cap; a timeout on the final text
Preload the category list and popular facets; a new category may run longer
Abort with the reason timeout; speak resolves on end, error or a watchdog
Speculate on a stable partial with its own controller; show it only if the final draft matches

blocks.title: Voice shopping failure playbook
rows: Dismissed: keep talk for a retry; denied: aria-disabled talk and how to allow it
No microphone, or an insecure page
Bad JSON or an unrelated request
not-understood or out-of-scope; transcript to the text box
A closed socket or a network error
connection-lost; the final or partial text to the text box

blocks.title: Scenario walkthrough: a cancelled turn and an empty result

steps.title: A request is in flight
steps.text: After the six blue shoes, the shopper says in red, and turn t_3 is thinking.

steps.title: The shopper changes it
steps.text: Before t_3 lands, the shopper taps talk and says actually in black. t_3 is aborted with the reason 'cancel', and t_4 commits four black shoes.

steps.title: A stale reply is ignored
steps.text: A t_3 reply that had already resolved reaches the store, but t_3 is not the active turn, so it changes nothing.

steps.title: The search empties
steps.text: Only waterproof ones in stock, says the shopper. Turn t_5 sets inStockOnly and a query of waterproof, which the transcript contains, and lands with total 0.

steps.title: Undo recovers it
steps.text: The voice says no matches, and the chips stay. The shopper taps Undo, a direct turn restores the four black shoes, and no model call is made.

blocks.alt: State diagram of idle, listening, thinking and speaking, where talk cancels a busy turn and text turns skip the voice.
blocks.caption: Phases: talk cancels a busy turn and listens again, text and direct turns skip the voice, and Cancel or Escape returns to idle.
blocks.fallbackText: Text fallback: Talk moves idle to listening once the microphone is live, and talk or silence moves it to thinking. A voice turn then speaks a summary, a choice or a line and returns to idle; text and direct turns, or replies off, skip speaking. Talk during thinking or speaking cancels and listens again, and Cancel or Escape returns to idle.

blocks.title: Voice shopping tests that protect shoppers
items: Tap talk during the summary; assert speech stops first and no track is live while speaking.
Cancel a thinking turn; assert no message, unchanged chips, and that its reply changes nothing.
Return a size outside the facets; assert a choice that keeps the category and price.
Return choice options outside the facets, or a query word the transcript lacks; assert they are rejected.
Run keyboard and screen-reader passes over talk, Cancel, the choices and the announcements.

blocks.text: The model is measured too. Its schema makes only the category an enum, recorded transcripts with expected patches catch regressions, and an injected instruction can at worst yield a reply that validation bounds.
